environment: Mac M4 Max macOS 26.6.2 client; Colima 0.9.1 VZ Linux arm64, 6 vCPU, 8 GiB RAM, 85 GiB guest data disk; Docker Engine 28.4.0, Compose 5.7.0
distribution: One shared Uvicorn port; warm one persistent HTTP connection per PUT and balance by worker PID before timing; require PUT response from assigned PID.
connection_budget: Four total app pool slots in each case, backed by PostgreSQL LIMIT 4 for a non-superuser application role. Administration and diagnostics use a separate role.
guarantees: One synchronous transaction per PUT; receipt and rows commit together. Restart and sampled stored-field checks are outside the timing.
upload_timing: From the simultaneous scheduling of PUTs until the final HTTP 201; includes normal database pool acquisition and any lazy connection setup, excludes HTTP keepalive warmup.
resource_sampling_scope: Docker stats snapshots about every 11 seconds during upload, includes writer parent and worker processes; first snapshot may include startup/connection warmup.

cases.memory_sampling_scope: client only: upload and count verification
cases.postgres_version: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

diagnostics.scope: Activity during concurrent PUTs; no per-stream client yield timing
diagnostics.counter_scope: pg_stat_database: current database; other views: whole cluster
diagnostics.counter_window: Before activity monitor connect through shutdown and 1s collector settle; may include background work and publication lag
